title: Rigorous Resolution of the Two-Qubit Maximal Magic Conjecture via SO(6) Geometry and Certified Equivariant Sum-of-Squares Proofs
description: Complete, pure-kernel Lean 4 formalization (32 audited declarations, zero sorry, zero native_decide, standard foundational axioms only), reproducible C++17/Python exact degree-8 equivariant sum-of-squares (SOS) certificate discovery pipeline, standalone zero-dependency Python verifier (< 1 s), and full manuscript resolving the two-qubit (n = 2) maximal magic conjecture of Liu, Low, and Yin (Quantum Sci. Technol. 11, 015035, 2026) for all Renyi orders alpha >= 2, including the sharp upper bound max M_2 = ln(16/7), complete classification of all 480 maximizers as a single Clifford orbit coinciding with two-qubit Pauli 5-MUB fiducial states, and the exact Wootters concurrence dichotomy C in {1/2, 1/sqrt(2)} with 192 / 288 state counts. All formalized theorems are independently verified end-to-end by the deterministic Lean 4 kernel (Audit.lean; zero sorry, zero native_decide, standard axioms only) and standalone exact integer arithmetic (scripts/verify_certificate.py), and literature citations were checked against primary sources.
